verdict.rationale: Mercury's first-party docs say it pays recipients over ACH, check, domestic wire and international wire, with optional approval controls. The same docs cover API-initiated payouts and approval-gated "request to send money" flows, and the marketing site describes bill-pay flows that remember past recipients. A long-time customer independently reports reliable wire transfers, though not ACH vendor payments specifically. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of ACH vendor payments and detail on fees and cutoff times for domestic ACH and wire.
